blocks.content: In the first part of this interactive C++ course, we learned the fundamental concepts of C++ and programming in general. If the concepts below don't ring a bell, we suggest taking the C++ Basics Course first.
However, if you are comfortable writing programs involving these topics, it's time to delve into C++ more deeply. That's what this course is about.
This course will focus on Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
After learning OOP, you will gain a much deeper understanding of C++ and be ready to write more complex and real-world programs.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
